review:
Tiger Legends is a 5x4 martial-arts slot with four animal warriors. A Legendary Frame that lands on a high-paying Warrior symbol can expand it into a Legendary Frame Warrior covering a much larger area, which turns one premium symbol into a stack that's easy to connect.

The bonus rounds supercharge the frames. The presentation is cinematic, with dojo backdrops and fluid character art, and the 10,000x maximum is available in every mode. This is one of the studio's more straightforward recent games, a good one to try if the mechanic-heavy titles seem too complex.
